CGG helps Cursor finish the user's goal: remember it across chats, send unfinished work back to the agent, and independently check the result.

This release connects the components around that job:

- **Goal loop:** DeepSeek Harness controls status and rounds; Codex supplies accounting, optional budgets and continuation instructions. Relevant prior work and checks come back with the goal.
- **Independent review:** CGG checks the actual project and Google ADK evaluates the recorded work and supplied evidence. Findings focus on missing work, demonstrated defects and meaningful unrequested changes.
- **Corrections and learning:** specific panel/chat corrections help the next review and become inputs to bounded Google RRSI prompt learning. Qualified updates preserve useful findings and can be undone.
- **Updated material:** the listing, guides, interface wording, example workspace and illustrated tour now describe the same workflow. Visuals are labelled examples rendered from current source.

**Linux x64 only for this release**, including Cursor connected to WSL Ubuntu. Download the attached Linux x64 VSIX. Completion review needs `cursor-agent` installed and signed in to your Cursor account. CGG's other runtimes are bundled.

Reviews can be wrong or incomplete. Existing real-model learning and native connection checks have different scopes; naturally accumulated user-feedback improvement and a fresh full native search/adoption sequence are not claimed. See the [verification guide](https://github.com/khalidsaidi/cursor-goal-guardian/blob/main/docs/verification.md).

The [Open VSX listing](https://open-vsx.org/extension/khalidsaidi/cursor-goal-guardian-extension) may lag registry publication. Check the version and target; older platform packages are not validation of this build.
